newsitem.title: CHINA: Good market helps Shanghai Tyre in '96.
newsitem.headline: Good market helps Shanghai Tyre in '96.

text.p: Shanghai Tyre and Rubber Co Ltd said on Thursday that good market conditions and improved management helped the company turn a net profit in 1996, reversing the losses of 1995.

The opening of the Shanghai-Nanjing expressway in 1996 helped the company sell more radial passenger car tyres, the firm's major product, the company said in its 1996 annual report, published in the Shanghai Securities News.
The company acquired the bankrupt Haikou Tyre Plant in 1996, which helped it to expand market share, and developed 33 types of new tyres, helping improve sales, the report said.
Post-tax profit for 1996 was 109.128 million yuan, reversing a loss in 1995 of 170.51 million yuan under international accounting standards, the report said.
Turnover rose to 3.98 billion yuan from 3.41 billion yuan based on domestic accounting standards, it said.

The company's board of directors proposed to offer a pre-tax cash dividend of 0.15 yuan per share for all shareholders, pending shareholder approval at a meeting scheduled for May 18, a statement by the board said.
